svg.text: The scanner holds only roles/cloudasset.viewer + bigquery.jobUser + logging.logWriter at project level, plus dataset-scoped BigQuery editor and topic-scoped publisher.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The dashboard SA can only SELECT from this dataset. No service-account keys exist (and the organization forbids creating them). Nothing is publicly invokable.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Live: world-open SSH/RDP + allow-all firewalls, public bucket, BigQuery dataset shared with allAuthenticatedUsers, public Cloud Run service, Editor on a service account,

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plus the project's own pre-existing gaps (default network, stale IAM bindings, no audit config). Unit-test only: UBLA-off buckets and SA keys (the organization blocks creating them),

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and VM rules (a VM is not free). The README table says which is which.

Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cloud Scheduler calls the Cloud Run Admin API to start the job with its own service account's OAuth token

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The job lists assets of 8 types twice: RESOURCE (configuration) and IAM_POLICY (who can do what)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The snapshot is piped to `opa eval`; every rule in policies/posture.rego runs; the findings set comes back

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Findings are normalised to the common schema (stable fingerprint, severity, CIS mapping, remediation) and MERGEd: open / refresh / resolve

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Newly opened (or reopened) HIGH and CRITICAL findings are published to Pub/Sub with the remediation text

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The same findings are logged as JSON lines with alert=true

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A log-based metric counts them; an alert policy emails on any in 24h. A second policy alerts if the job itself fails

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The dashboard queries only the views v_open_findings, v_recently_resolved, v_scan_history

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The operator reaches the private service through `gcloud run services proxy`, which attaches their identity token

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Checkov output for Terraform is normalised into the same schema (source=checkov); sources never resolve each other's findings
